name: leaki
description: Leaki — Catálogo de repetição espaçada (Capacitor Android)

scripts.web: npm run build && npm run prepare:web && node scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build && npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
